_README: FUNDING DATA — single source of truth for money figures.
Feeds BOTH the homepage summary bar and the full tracker on the
HOW TO UPDATE: edit the numbers below, set 'asOf' to today's
date (YYYY-MM-DD), save, commit, push. Both pages update.
asOf        — date the figures were last checked (shown on site)
raised      — total raised so far, in US dollars (number, no commas)
phaseGoal   — goal for the current priority phase, in dollars
phaseLabel  — one line describing the current priority
totalGoal   — full amount needed to open, in dollars
items       — budget line items; label + cost in dollars
